reviewType: Fresh-context independent read-only prospective R3 freshness policy correction review and remediation recheck

findings.title: Reject normalized invalid timestamps
findings.description: The initial candidate accepted impossible dates and hour 24 because Date.parse normalized them. Synthetic February 30 and hour-24 inputs produced sanitizer PASS.
findings.resolution: The final candidate requires an exact normalized UTC round-trip. Invalid calendar and clock components fail, while valid leap days and supported fractional-second precision remain accepted.

dispositions.target: Prospective freshness policy before source calls
dispositions.rationale: Strict UTC round-trip validation restores the approved valid-timestamp requirement for file metadata, revision metadata and capture-observation intervals.
dispositions.verification: Independently reran the expanded synthetic sanitizer and sequence tests. Invalid February 30, hour 24, non-leap February 29, April 31 and minute 60 are rejected; valid leap day and fractional timestamps pass.

assessment.authority: The implemented correction matches the directly approved, hash-pinned proposal. It removes cross-resource timestamp equality without introducing tolerance, rounding or additional access.
assessment.freshness: Four ordered observations require separately unchanged file timestamps, revision timestamps and connector-reported tokens around two equal complete bounded captures.
assessment.privacy: The sanitizer retains only permitted minimal evidence, discards editor attribution and rejects unexpected metadata, invalid tokens, missing or ambiguous matching records and cap-reaching pages.
assessment.attempts: Attempt 1 remains consumed; only attempts 2 and 3 are permitted.
assessment.preservation: Original grants, proposals, review bindings, failed observations, historical evidence, product bytes and reserved R4 effects remain preserved.

errors: PLAN-REV18 requires a committed manifest/review attestation in current history

limits: PASS applies only to this prospective policy correction and exact final manifest. Persist the matching review before further authorized source calls.
Exact file/title/header/grid/native projection completeness and deterministic capture-digest provenance remain caller obligations; synthetic sequence validation does not establish them.
No live workbook observation was repeated. Stable connector observations do not prove actual server head, atomic snapshot, complete revision history or current official scholarship facts.
Source reconciliation and mapping review must precede product edits; final R3 review and separate R4 authority remain required.
Full test, typecheck and build evidence was inspected rather than rerun. The narrow remediation received independent targeted validation.
The three reserved canonical diagnostics remain explicit failures.
